title.zh: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
title.en: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks

current_state.zh: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech launched a coalition to promote issuer-backed tokenized stocks that tie onchain shares directly to official shareholder records, following the SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized equity trading.
